title: Spitfire Wood-Fired Kiln - Workshop
source_quote: The Spitfire Workshop - $450 for those with little or no wood firing experience and an assistant.
evidence_sentence: The Spitfire Workshop is a $450 one-day wood firing for participants with little or no prior wood-firing experience, with kiln loading and firing in 10 hours.
evidence_quote: Spitfire Schedule: Arrive 8:30am Load kiln 9am-11am Light and fire kiln until 9pm (10 hours) Unloading is a minimum of 2 days later
summary: One-day workshop firing the 3-cubic-foot Spitfire wood kiln: load 9–11 a.m., fire until 9 p.m. (10 hours), unload minimum 2 days later. For those with little or no prior wood-firing experience. $450 includes an assistant.
commitment: Arrive 8:30 a.m., load 9–11 a.m., fire until 9 p.m., unload 2+ days later
cost_text: $450 for little/no experience; includes an assistant
